usersHint: The owner issues accounts. Public registration is closed.
usersLastOwnerHint: The last owner stays: give someone else the owner role first.
usersRoleHint: Viewers see status and stability. Operators control Docker, files and terminals: this is trusted, host-level access without security isolation from the owner. Owners also manage users, agents and settings.

stabilityDescription: Docker state and time since the last container start, grouped by stack and server.
stabilityMethod: Availability is the running share of observed time, not HTTP availability. Gaps stay unobserved. Percentages appear after 30 minutes of data; containers are sampled once a minute. "Unknown" is not a container fault: it means the last observation is older than 90 seconds, so the panel says it does not know rather than assuming everything is still fine.
stabilityEmpty: Docker was checked. No containers on this server.
stabilityOfflineDescription: This server is not connected. Current state and running time are unknown.
stabilityRequestError: Could not read observations. Previously received data is shown as stale.
stabilityDockerError: The last Docker observation failed. Current state and running time are unknown.
stabilityNoObservation: Waiting for the first Docker observation after Dockge starts. This can take up to a minute.
stabilityStale: Observations are out of date. Current state and running time are unknown.
stabilityHistoryLabel: {0}, {1}: {2}. Observation coverage {3}. Blank parts have no observations.
authStatusUnavailable: Could not read the status. Retry or contact the owner.
authAgentRateLimited: The agent limited sign-in attempts. Automatic retries did not succeed; reconnect later.

gitUiComposeFileHelp: A file at the repository root, such as compose.yaml or docker-compose.yml.

gitUiRequestFailed: The request failed. Check the connection and try again.
gitUiChangesDescription: Choose which changes to bring to the server.
gitUiReviewDescription: Files will only be written after confirmation.
gitUiFetching: Fetching changes from Git and comparing them with the server files.
gitUiLocalRemains: The selected local versions remain different from Git.
gitUiNoChangesDescription: The server files match the selected Git branch. No file update is needed.
gitUiChooseEveryFile: Choose a result for each file
gitUiUnchangedUntilApply: Server files stay unchanged until you apply the result.
gitUiRedactedFile: The contents are hidden because this file may contain secrets. Your choice applies to the entire file.
gitUiBinaryFile: Binary file: a text comparison is unavailable. Your choice applies to the entire file.
gitUiApplyDescription: Validate Compose with the selected files, write the result, pull images and recreate changed services.
gitUiRestartImpact: Services may briefly be unavailable during restart. File changes do not roll back container data.
gitUiApplying: Validating and applying the selected files, then running Compose. Please wait for the result.
gitUiPreserveText: Comments and formatting in the selected files are preserved. This update does not push changes to the repository.
gitUiPreviewExpiry: The server rechecks the files before writing. If they changed or 10 minutes passed, a new comparison is required.
gitUiUpdateSavedDescription: The selected files are saved on the server. Running services were not recreated.
gitUiEditAfterSave: To combine edits manually, save without starting, then open the stack files in the editor.
gitUiResultUnknown: The connection was lost before a result arrived. The operation may have continued on the server. Check the stack files and status before trying again.
gitUiPreviewTimeout: Git did not respond within 90 seconds. Check repository access on the server and retry the comparison.
gitUiEditedFileRule: The draft stays in memory until applied. Empty text saves an empty file. To delete a file, choose the side where it is absent.
gitUiResultValidated: Before writing, the result is validated as Compose and every source file is checked again.
